title: Unemployed young people to join AI boot camps to get job-ready

paragraphs.en: Young people out of work or at risk of unemployment in the UK are to join “AI boot camps” where they harness the technology to get a foothold in the workplace.
paragraphs.zh: 英国失业或面临失业风险的年轻人将参加“AI训练营”，在那里利用这一技术在职场上站稳脚跟。

paragraphs.en: The government’s latest attempt to address the crisis in Neets – young people not in work or education – involves turning to a technology that many view as a potential threat to employment.
paragraphs.zh: 政府为解决“尼特族”（不上学也不工作的年轻人）危机的最新尝试，是转向一种许多人视为就业潜在威胁的技术。

paragraphs.en: A pilot in north-west England will provide up to 70 people aged 16 to 21 with three weeks of AI training, including learning to build AI tools, understanding how businesses use AI and learning to use the technology responsibly. There will also be workplace skills training such as in using office IT systems and timekeeping.
paragraphs.zh: 英格兰西北部的一个试点项目将为最多70名16至21岁的年轻人提供为期三周的AI培训，包括学习构建AI工具、了解企业如何使用AI，以及学习负责任地使用这项技术。此外还会有职场技能培训，如办公IT系统的使用和时间管理。

paragraphs.en: The government wants the majority of attenders at the boot camp to gain an apprenticeship at local businesses that have signed up, including the defence firm BAE Systems and the food company Heinz.
paragraphs.zh: 政府希望训练营的大多数参与者都能在已签约的当地企业获得学徒机会，这些企业包括国防公司BAE系统公司和食品公司亨氏。

paragraphs.en: Lisa Nandy, the digital, culture, media and sport secretary, said the scheme would “support young people at a crucial juncture in their lives”. The pilot will be used to refine an England-wide AI skills scheme due to roll out next summer.
paragraphs.zh: 数字、文化、媒体和体育大臣丽莎·南迪（Lisa Nandy）表示，该计划将“在年轻人人生的关键时刻给予支持”。该试点将用于完善一项定于明年夏天在全英格兰推出的AI技能计划。

paragraphs.en: The boot camp will use AI tools from US tech firms including Microsoft, the ChatGPT developer OpenAI and Anthropic, the startup behind the Claude chatbot.
paragraphs.zh: 训练营将使用包括微软、ChatGPT开发商OpenAI以及Claude聊天机器人背后的初创公司Anthropic在内的美国科技公司的AI工具。

paragraphs.en: Bouke Klein Teeselink, an academic at King’s College London and an expert on the impact of AI on work, said the boot camp was a “good idea in principle”.
paragraphs.zh: 伦敦国王学院研究AI对工作影响的学者布克·克莱因·特塞林克（Bouke Klein Teeselink）表示，训练营“原则上是个好主意”。

paragraphs.en: “What we need to do is make juniors more attractive to companies and one way to do that is make them more productive by teaching them how to do AI well,” he said.
paragraphs.zh: 他说：“我们需要做的是让初级员工对公司更具吸引力，而方法之一就是通过教他们如何用好AI来提高他们的生产力。”
